name: Nilgiri
description: Upside down on sand; soft corals on the hull and a large swim-through. The narrative calls this vessel a tugboat.

name: Thermopylae (T) Sierra
description: Cargo holds and overhangs create complex habitat; highest vertical relief among Colombo wrecks.

name: Medhufaru
description: Open cabins, cargo holds and intact superstructure; little hard or soft coral.

name: Barracuda Reef
description: Part of a continuous sandstone ridge parallel to the coast; cracks, small overhangs and limited vertical relief.

name: Anchor Point
description: Part of the same approximately 5 km sandstone ridge, colonized by corals, gorgonians and sea whips.

name: New Reef (Mid Point)
description: A surveyed section of the continuous sandstone ridge, not a mapped reef boundary.
